title: My account
subtitle: Your details, your password, and deleting your account.
metaDescription: Manage your profile, your password and your data on vélo-atelier.

signedInWith.password: Signs in with email and password.
signedInWith.both: Signs in with email and password, or with Google.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: The name shown in the menu, and the language of the interface.
profile.emailHint: The address cannot be changed for now.
profile.name: First name or nickname

password.changeDescription: After a change, your other devices are signed out within five minutes.
password.setDescription: Your account signs in with Google. Add a password so you can sign in without it.
password.reauthDescription: To add a password, first confirm it is you with Google. This stops a stolen session from taking over your account.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.description: Your bikes, checkups and lists are deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
delete.dialogDescription: Everything goes: {bikes} and the history of your checkups. There is no bin to restore from.
delete.bikesCount: {count, plural, =0 {no bike} one {# bike} other {# bikes}}

import.metaDescription: Move the bike, the checkup and the list you prepared on this device into your account.
import.title: Import my bike
import.done: Your bike is saved to your account.
import.alreadyDone: That bike was already in your account.
import.failedHelp: The import did not go through. Your bike is still on this device: nothing is lost.

guestBanner.title: A bike is waiting on this device
guestBanner.text: You described this bike while signed out. Import it to find it on all your devices.
